responsibility: Defines the common `AstLike` abstraction for AST nodes and macro nonterminals that may carry attributes and retained token streams. This file centralizes uniform access to `attrs` and optional `LazyTokenStream` storage across items, statements, expressions, patterns, types, visibility, and wrappers, including whether a node can host custom inner attributes, so parser, token collection, and macro-expansion code can manipulate heterogeneous AST fragments through one interface.
